verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a terminal/SSH client, so grouping sessions and broadcasting input is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows creating and switching between multiple shells and tabs, with nothing about grouping sessions or sending one command to several at once. Having multiple sessions is a related feature, not the broadcast capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them
